name: Assigned Agents
reason: Army Rule of the Agents of the Imperium: any Imperium army may include Agents, at the cost the Munitorum Field Manual lists under “Every Model Has The Imperium Keyword”, up to a number of Retinue, Character and Requisitioned units set by the battle size; a Dedicated Transport must start the battle with a unit embarked.

name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
reason: Army Rule of the Drukhari (errata): Harlequins and Anhrathe units up to a points total set by the battle size, never the Warlord and without Enhancements. BSData lists them in the codex itself.

name: Cult of the Dark Gods
reason: Army Rule of the Chaos Space Marines: Khorne Berzerkers, Rubric Marines, Plague Marines and Noise Marines, up to a points total set by the battle size. BSData already copies them into the codex with the Heretic Astartes faction keyword, so they are named here.

name: Daemonic Pact
reason: Army Rule of the Chaos Space Marines and Chaos Knights: Legiones Daemonica units up to a points total set by the battle size, never the Warlord, without Enhancements, no more non-Battleline than Battleline units of each god; per the FAQ, their Shadow of Chaos army rules are not in effect.

name: Dreadblades
reason: Army Rule of the Chaos Knights: any Chaos army may include one Titanic Chaos Knights model or up to three War Dog models, never the Warlord and without Enhancements.

name: Freeblades
reason: Army Rule of the Imperial Knights: any Imperium army may include one Titanic Imperial Knights model or up to three Armiger models, never the Warlord and without Enhancements.

name: Harlequins
reason: Army Rule of the Aeldari: a Craftworlds army may include Harlequins units, with no limit; only the badge tells them apart.
